description: A pending typed binding through a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose dependent value binding names fixture-value, a known binding codec no processor installs, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template beside a consumer crate. The exercise pins that the schema loads under the standard extensions, that the generated reader's reading succeeds, and that each deferred payload streams as a typed pending-binding item right after the contribution holding its reference, carrying the bound target field, the reference, and the raw payload, a list for several values and the single value alone
